method: Full wall and preview inspected locally; pixel comparison against Gathering 15.
visual_review: Warm rock, cracks, roots, lighting, framing and all ancestor marks retained. Pepe has a wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. Both hands have four fingers and one thumb. Four ochre pebbles and a chalk center occupy bare upper-right rock. No letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, border, political or hateful symbols observed.
limitations: Local visual review, not independent certification.
Tiny pigment detail is reduced in 512px preview.
